prompt:
CHARACTER: the same woman as the attached image — Duskull (해골몽) personified, ghost type. Keep her face, eye and hair colors, haircut, skin tone and body proportions; expression and hair motion may change.

STYLE: Premium glossy anime promotional key art with clean linework, vivid controlled color, dimensional 2.5D shading and dense but organized clothing and accessory detail. Render the face and outfit at the same polished intensity.

OUTPUT: one standalone off-duty scene of her. Everyday clothing chosen for the scene; her species shows only as a small accessory, a motif on the clothing or a color echo — never armor, never a creature costume. Scene, outfit, pose and camera follow the settings below.

WARDROBE: change her clothes completely. From the attached image take only her face, hair and body — not its armor, garment, layers, sash, tassels, jewelry, hair ornaments or background. Dress her exactly as the scene settings below describe; that outfit must read at first glance, keeping its own recognisable colours and parts. Her source may add one small accent at most — never restyle the chosen outfit into her own costume, genre or palette.

SCENE (chosen):
Expression: narrowed sparkling eyes, one brow up, closed-lip grin pushed to one side
Pose: Carry the scene's bag, basket or box with believable hand contact and weight.
Orientation: front three-quarter body turn of about 30-45 degrees; rotate torso and pelvis together
Scene: Cleaned shallow metal trays and coiled equipment leads rest on a service cart as she arranges the trays beside a care-station connector panel under bright ceiling lights.
Outfit and props: A cropped graphite work vest with an open back over a fitted opaque dark top, short tailored shorts, and practical ankle shoes, exposing waist and legs.
Category: Show one believable working moment in the Pokémon world. Choose care, research, conservation, berry cultivation, crafts, travel, contests or battle support. Make the profession readable through a concrete task, practical clothing and relevant tools. Preserve the approved woman; invent her own workwear instead of copying an existing trainer, Gym Leader or Pokémon Center character.
Example scene: Pokémon Center equipment attendant checking care-station connections and arranging cleaned trays in a service room.
Framing: Three-quarter portrait framing from the head to just above the knees, with the scene's hand action readable.
Lens / perspective: 24mm-equivalent wide-angle impression with spacious environmental depth; use enough camera distance to avoid stretching the face or limbs.
Camera: Vertical 2:3 portrait (1024×1536).
overall_intensity: strong — maximal styling presence within the scene; retain chosen exposure and anatomy
skin_exposure: bold — more scene-appropriate shoulder, back, midriff or leg exposure; cover chest and pelvis
action_level: balanced — a readable moment of gentle movement, not a ratio of multiple images
source_influence: subtle — one restrained source-color accent or small accessory
separates_preference: prefer separates — prefer separate top and bottom unless outfit is explicitly specified

ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no creature beside her, no text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border.

ANATOMY: natural adult proportions. No body-part enlargement, no extra limbs; her worn features are costume, never extra limbs.

HANDS: each hand has one thumb and four fingers, the thumb on its inner side, never merged, doubled, mirrored or extra.
